关键词: Direxion Daily Junior Gold Miners Index Bull and Bear 3x ETF
主要内容: The Best (and Worst) Investments of 2016, published on December 27, 2016, by 24/7 Wall St., provides a comprehensive review of the top and worst investments of the year. The U.S. stock market continued to recover, with the S&P 500 rising by about 11%. Commodities, particularly energy and metals, performed well, while agricultural commodities struggled. The S&P GSCI, a widely tracked commodities index, rose by 12% in 2016. The U.S. dollar also strengthened, reaching a 13-year high. Among the best investments, the US Global Investors World Precious Minerals Fund (UNWPX) outperformed the S&P 500 by over 50 percentage points, returning about 60% year to date. The fund focuses on precious minerals such as gold, silver, and platinum. Meanwhile, NVDA, a chipmaker, saw its shares rise by 230%, making it the best-performing large-cap stock. On the other hand, Endo International's shares fell by nearly 75%, marking one of the worst-performing stocks. The article also notes that the Venezuelan bolivar was the worst-performing currency in 2016 due to the drop in oil prices, which heavily impacted the country's economy. The review includes data from various sources, such as Morningstar for mutual funds and ETFs, Bloomberg for commodities, and Google Finance for currency data. In 2016, several investments stood out as top performers. The PureFunds ISE Junior Silver ETF, which tracks the price movement of silver, saw its share price rise by 122% year-to-date. Leveraged ETFs, such as the one that began the year around $25 a unit and is now traded at over $60 a unit, provided a 140% return. Nvidia, a semiconductor maker, was the only S&P 500 company to more than triple its share value, with its share price surging from just over $32 to over $100. Acacia Communications, Inc., an IPO in 2016, saw its shares rise over 110% after strong earnings reports. Zinc, a commodity, climbed nearly 70% year-to-date, outperforming other commodities. The Brazilian real appreciated by about 20% against the U.S. dollar, marking a significant turnaround. High-yield corporate bonds also outperformed the S&P 500, making 2016 the third best year for the asset class in the past two decades.

股票实体.名称: US Global Investors World Precious Minerals Fund
